title: Comet NEOWISE Rising over the Adriatic Sea
explanation:
# Comet NEOWISE: A Celestial Wake-Up Call

In July 2020, an icy wanderer called Comet NEOWISE—a five-kilometer-wide mountain of frozen gases and dust from the outer reaches of our solar system—made a rare appearance bright enough to see without telescopes, delighting early risers across the Northern Hemisphere. A photographer captured the spectacular moment in a time-lapse video showing the comet rising like a ghostly apparition over Italy's Adriatic Sea, its luminous tails streaming behind it against a backdrop of shimmering, wave-like clouds and distant stars.
